text: Core courses Higher Mathematics, University Physics, Engineering Mathematics (Linear Algebra, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, etc.), Engineering Mechanics, Engineering Cartography and Computer Graphics, Safety System Engineering, Safety Human-Machinery Engineering, Principle of Safety, Safety Management, Civil Engineering Safety, Management of Dangerous Sources of Electro-mechanics, Safety Evaluation and Technology of Safety Monitoring. Objective This objective is to train students to be comprehensive, interdisciplinary, high-quality engineering and managerial specialized personnel, who will be able to work in the fields of Safe Technology, Design of Security System, Safety Management, Safety Supervision and Control, Safety Training, Safety Evaluation, Safety Economy and Safety Information, all the fields being related with civil engineering construction, electro-mechanics and dangerous chemical products. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Engineering is granted.
